audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers of the level chart hand Levels 1-6 to Camille (or 'Skill'), while every whys[] line, the packet levelChart (Illaoi for rows 0-5, Camille row 6), the 52.03% win rate over 938 games, diff FAV, and the already-audited mirror (Camille 43.99% over 341 games) all say Illaoi owns the lane until late.
audit.why: phases[N].side and win[N] render the same row; they agreed with each other but contradicted the packet, the prose and the mirror, so the page told a paying user the opposite of its own explanation.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 flipped to Illaoi in both layers with ratings raised to 7/10; row 6 stays Camille, matching the packet chart and the mirror. breakdown.difficulty, report[2], report[14] and diffRating re-scored to match a favoured lane.

audit.why: Spikes read levels 3-5 (full pattern), level 6, first item, late — matching Illaoi's real curve. Camille's spikes are Hookshot online, 6, and item scaling.
audit.corrected: Kept the spike structure; only tightened spikes[1] and spikes[3] where the mechanics were misstated (see point 4). Level-6 line now keys R to her commit rather than describing it as a wall, and the late spike names the ult correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: winCon told you to 'E her grounded' and spikes[1]/whys[4] called Leap of Faith a 'wall'. Riot's text for Leap of Faith is damage plus one Tentacle per champion hit — no grounding, no wall, no untargetability. spikes[1] also credited Tactical Sweep with 'true-damage healing'; the true damage belongs to the empowered second hit of Precision Protocol (Q), while Tactical Sweep is the heal. dosFull[2] said 'Build armor' with a description about wasting Hookshot, and its advice ignored that Q's empowered hit ignores armour.
audit.why: The Illaoi kit file flags R as grounding/untargetable/zone — those flags contradict Riot's own description and are tooltip-parse misfires (the same class of misfire the mirror recorded on Camille's R being flagged channel/untargetable). Advice built on a grounding that does not exist gets a player killed baiting a dash that never gets denied.
audit.corrected: R is stated as damage plus a Tentacle per champion hit, held for her commit. The real denial of Hookshot is terrain, not grounding: it needs a wall, so open lane leaves it dead for its 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown. True damage attributed to the empowered Q, healing to Tactical Sweep, and the armour advice corrected to armour plus health with Grievous Wounds for the W heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: The ability name 'Hextech Ultimatum' is used in spikes[3], whys[6] and late; Riot's name is The Hextech Ultimatum.
audit.why: Packet flagged it as a probable wrong name (distance 4) and the enemy kit confirms the full name.
audit.corrected: All three occurrences renamed to The Hextech Ultimatum.

audit.why: Executioner's Calling is already called out, which is exactly the anti-heal timing the missing-interactions file asks for against Tactical Sweep.

audit.whatIsWrong: Camille is referred to as 'he'/'him' in tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d, breakdown.trading and report[3].t.
audit.why: Camille is female; the mixed pronouns read as copied boilerplate and undercut trust in the rest of the page.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected in place at identical length.

notes: Illaoi's kit file flags R (Leap of Faith) as grounding / untargetable / zone. Riot's own description is damage plus one Tentacle per champion hit — no grounding and no untargetability. Treated as a tooltip-parse misfire and every claim built on it removed (winCon previously told the player to 'E her grounded', which is not a thing Illaoi can do). This matches the mirror's finding that Camille's R was wrongly flagged channel/untargetable. Camille's Hookshot is denied by terrain, not by grounding: no wall nearby means no engage and no escape for 16/15/14/13/12s — that is the real punish window and it is now stated. Level chart was inverted in BOTH layers against the packet, the win rate, the prose and the mirror; flipped rows 0-5 as a matched pair set with ratings, row 6 left to Camille. diffRating moved 8.5 -> 4.5 with the two prose lines that quote it. Illaoi W (Harsh Lesson) is a 4s-cooldown dash-to-target with an auto reset — worth noting the packet's 'sequencingCues' but no edit needed.
